subject: Follow-up on MetaDefender Endpoint registration on your virtual desktops
body:
Dear Marcus,

Thank you for your time today. Here is a short summary.

What we found: the MetaDefender Endpoint log shows registration failing because the certificate chain is not trusted. The issuer is your network team's SSL inspection proxy. You also mentioned that your profile tool restores user profiles after Endpoint has started.

Scope: your virtual desktop platform, the profile tool and the SSL inspection proxy are third-party products and outside OPSWAT's scope. Your virtual desktop team, your network team and the vendors should handle them.

Next steps:
1. Me: confirm the MetaDefender Endpoint side against the full log and follow up by end of day tomorrow.
2. You: send the full Endpoint log from one affected desktop today.
3. You: pass this summary to your virtual desktop team and your network team.

Our documented guidance for non-persistent desktops: https://docs.example-opswat.invalid/endpoint/deployment/non-persistent-desktops

claims_needing_verification.claim: MetaDefender Endpoint itself is behaving as designed and nothing on the Endpoint side contributes.
claims_needing_verification.reason: Based on the log lines read out during the discussion; the full log has not been reviewed yet.
